Game Overview

Rabbit Samurai 3 is a platformer game built around guide your heroic rabbit samurai through a vibrant world using a versatile grappling hook to conquer puzzles and traverse diverse landscapes. Strategically plan your swings to scale heights and explore depths, all while nurturing curious jellyfish companions. Experience the thrill of precision and timing in every leap and swing.
